And in true New Mexico fashion, there's green chile on our table this year. If you're looking for inspiration, New Mexico Magazine has some delicious recipes, from calabacitas to green chile gravy: https://www.newmexicomagazine.org/thanksgiving-recipes/

What's the one New Mexican dish your family can't do Thanksgiving without? 

From my family to yours, Happy Thanksgiving, New Mexico!
